newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Kingsgate confident of strong full year.
newsitem.headline: Kingsgate confident of strong full year.

text.p: Kingsgate International Corp Ltd, controlled by CDL Hotels New Zealand Ltd, said on Thursday it remained confident of a strong profit for the full year.

The Hyatt Regency Hotel recorded a 5.5 percent increase in revenue due to improved room rates, which Kingsgate said was a reflection of the better product available following its refurbishment programme.

The imposition of a bed tax on gross room revenue by the New South Wales government of five percent in September 1997, but progressing to 10 percent over the next 12 months, could affect the company's profitability, Kingsgate said.
"But the Sydney hotel market continues to be buoyant and the outlook is one of optimism for the remainder of the year."
Kingsgate said it continued to benefit from the asset enhancement programmes carried out. The Birkenhead Quays Project was proceeding well and should provide development profits from 1998 onwards.
